notes.title: HotFix
notes.content: The hotfix of the previous hotfix.

notes.title: HotFix
notes.content: Added the ability to exit the stories menu via "esc".

notes.title: Stories
notes.content:
In the main menu, you can now view all stories of generals that you have opened after completing campaigns.
The main soundtrack has been improved. Now it hurts your ears less.
Improved the "how to win" icon.

notes.title: Images of capitals
notes.content:
Added images of capitals on the war progress scale.
Fixed a bug with a shadow when changing the battlefield.

notes.title: Improved tutorial
notes.content:
Fixed a bug with the absence of the "Next Chapter" button.
Supplemented the text in the training, emphasizing the points that the player may not understand.
If you were unable to complete the tutorial, try again now.

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
I corrected some numbers.
Changed the name "training" to "tutorial".

I also created a guide to your first step - https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2459792560

And a guide to the combat system for those who like to dive into the game with their heads - https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2459743983

notes.title: Update game
notes.content:
Increased damage from aircraft and artillery to aircraft and artillery.
Reversed specialization Zoldania and Kingdom of Greendagar. (logical error in the campaign)
Fix technical name of country in window with end of battle.
Fix  the opportunity to start the next campaign after the defeat.
Fix bag with endless spam of units.
Fix event window locations.
Fix the game freezes when troops retreat from the penultimate cell of the edge of the map.
Fix visual bug of displaying a captured unit on the board.

notes.title: HotFix
notes.content: Fixed stopping the game when switching the battlefield using hotkeys when there is a battle animation.

notes.title: HotFix
notes.content: The wrong territorial battlefield was being created.
